findings.label: Client-owned activity data written directly to DB
findings.summary: POST /api/replan trusts the client's activities payload and writes it to the DB without re-reading from the server. Stale or tampered client state silently overwrites DB records. Fix: re-fetch Activity.find({ date }) inside the route handler before calling replanEngine.

findings.label: Skipped-activity sentinel time persists in snapshotAfter
findings.summary: replanEngine marks skipped activities with start/end '23:59' as a sort sentinel. The live DB update correctly avoids writing those times, but snapshotAfter is built from finalActivities which still carries them. History snapshots show 23:59→23:59 for every skipped task. Fix: strip sentinel times before storing snapshotAfter, or use a dedicated _skipped flag.

findings.label: Done/partial activities can duplicate in merged output
findings.summary: The engine merges unchanged (done/partial) activities back into the final sorted result alongside newly scheduled activities. Two consecutive replans on the same day can produce two entries at the same time slot. Fix: deduplicate by _id before the final sort in replanEngine.
